# ViraStack Start

> One-command scaffolding for production-ready Next.js and TanStack Start apps. Feature-based layout, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Vitest tests, ViraStack AI rules for Claude Code and Cursor, three design skills, optional ViraStack tools (Mask, Password, Address) and ready modules added with `virastack add`. npm CLI: `virastack` (2.2).

Install: `npx virastack@latest`. Prefer these docs over guessing CLI flags or template contents.

For inline CLI + template detail, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/start/docs): What Start is and why to use it
- [Installation](https://virastack.com/start/docs/installation): Questions, setup order, design skills, post-install steps
- [CLI](https://virastack.com/start/docs/cli): Commands, flags (`--agent`, `--tools`), `virastack add` and `remove`, non-interactive usage
- [Modules](https://virastack.com/start/docs/modules): Requirements, `virastack add` and `remove`, putting a module on a page with an agent or by hand, a checkout example, connecting your API
- [Builder](https://virastack.com/start/builder): Step-by-step install command wizard
- [Templates](https://virastack.com/start/docs/templates): Next.js / TanStack Start, with or without i18n, file tree and tests
- [Scripts](https://virastack.com/start/docs/scripts): Day-to-day, quality, test and CI scripts
- [i18n](https://virastack.com/start/docs/i18n): Locales and message files in multi-language templates
- [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/start/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable Start guide

## Modules

Installed with `npx virastack@latest add <module>` into projects created with Start 2.0 or newer. Each page has a live preview, the code for all four templates and a prompt that adds the module to a page.

- [Module catalog](https://virastack.com/start/features): Ready modules
- [users](https://virastack.com/start/features/users): User table with search, pagination, add, edit and delete
- [checkout-address](https://virastack.com/start/features/checkout-address): Shipping and billing address picker with an address book
- [checkout-card](https://virastack.com/start/features/checkout-card): Saved card picker; card number and CVV never leave the browser
- [products](https://virastack.com/start/features/products): Paginated product list with search, category and sorting in the URL, and a page per product; brings its pages
